test: real GPU streaming and entity churn
notes: Frames include CPU simulation, scene generation, GPU submission and synchronous GPU completion. Streaming and entity churn occur between measured frames. Pool lengths are high-water storage, not live use. RSS is sampled externally.
measurement_caveats: Real headless GPU rendering; no desktop compositor or window presentation is included.
Each frame synchronously waits for GPU completion; this limits pipelining and differs from the interactive frame loop.
Streaming, mesh uploads and create/destroy work are measured per round, outside frame percentiles.
External ps sampling is approximate; resident pages include native graphics driver caches and Goose data-stack high-water pages.
The final screenshot adds temporary readback/PNG memory. Stable pool counters and a finite RSS trace do not prove absence of all leaks.

earlier_bug_run.explanation: Initial test exposed a rendering bug: generic entity links used for AI and stress collection ownership were drawn as conveyor belts. Restricting conveyor drawing to building-to-building links removed unintended geometry. First run raw log is appended to gpu-stress.log.
